gen-gf-tilt-neon-outfit: A tube-like, constant-width stroke defines Tilt Neon, with a splayed c terminal and a tall lowercase that leaves the ascenders short. Outfit reads smoothly underneath, its curves stopping short of closing.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-plus-jakarta-sans: Loud tube-like letters from Tilt Neon, splayed c terminal and all. Plus Jakarta Sans does the precise work, a monoline build with curve endings kept well apart, while the heading simply grabs attention.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-sora: Sora reads precise and geometric, its curves turning corners without any pressure swell. But Tilt Neon stays the loud one, its constant-width tube strokes and large lowercase towering over Sora's moderate height.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk has counters that open like a cut reed and a ribbon of constant width forming each glyph. Tilt Neon above it is the shouter, bold and commanding, with a splayed c terminal and short ascenders.
gen-gf-turret-road-clash-grotesk: Clash Grotesk draws every stroke without any modulation, clean and approachable. Clash Grotesk then simply lets Turret Road's open-parenthesis rounds and pen-like line carry the bold, commanding look.
gen-gf-turret-road-fs-alpino: Turret Road's round forms read like open parentheses, drawn with a pen-like line of constant weight. Alpino feels cozy and casual next to it, tall enough that its ascenders look short.
gen-gf-turret-road-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk leaves its bowls unfinished on one side, and its lowercase stands tall against the capitals. But Turret Road's bold, pen-like line is what you notice first, with round forms like open parentheses.
gen-gf-turret-road-fs-hind: Turret Road is the loud half, bold and commanding, built from round forms and a pen-like line of constant weight. Hind does the steady work, with lowercase nearly matching its capitals.
gen-gf-turret-road-fs-nunito: Approachable describes Nunito, with big round lowercase bowls and terminals that stop well short of the stem. Turret Road does the bold, commanding part best, while Nunito handles the quieter running text.
gen-gf-turret-road-fs-pilcrow-rounded: A bold pen-like line crowns the pair, courtesy of Turret Road. Pilcrow Rounded does its best work lower down, with big counters in a tall lowercase and letter spaces shrunk to a thin crack.
